source_notes: Blank-ref fill (worklist blank_refs target). The Status [ref] cell was empty while Status='cancelled' / Substatus='inferred 4 y'. The cancellation is an inferred status (GEM ResearcherNotesUnit: 'GC, Sep 2024: Moved from Shelved to Cancelled. No news in more than four years.'), so there is no single discrete cancellation-event source; the [ref] documents the LNG-to-power proposal whose multi-year dormancy supports the inferred-cancelled status. Two independent non-GEM trade-press sources corroborate the Telfers Island LNG import / FSRU project: IJGlobal (archived) documents the LNG-to-power proposal, the FSRU, and LNG Group Panama / Panama NG Power; ICIS (2013) independently documents the Telfers Island import terminal, the FSRU, the Panama NG Power 500MW tender, and the LNG Group Panama / Gunvor agreement. BNamericas project profile is a third (mostly paywalled) corroboration of the Telfers project. Using the archived (web.archive.org) version of IJGlobal because the live ijglobal.com URL is paywalled. url_verifier PASS: IJGlobal on 'Panama LNG'; ICIS on 'Panama NG Power' and 'Telfers Island'; BNamericas on 'Telfers'.
scope_note: Telfers FSRU only; not applied to other Panama rows.
